$description: The Field Work — the-lit-clearing. DARK-DEFAULT token set: the near-black plum ground (#160712) IS the base theme, not an alternate. The blush pool (#FBF3F1) is a per-surface inversion documented under color.pool, not a page-level light mode — see src/tokens/README.md before touching anything here.

50.$description: blush — pool surface / inverted text on dark

950.$description: background — exact brand value, the deepest ground in the direction

500.$description: primary / magenta-deep — exact brand value. POOL-ONLY: 3.45:1 on the dark ground (fails AA body); 5.18:1 on the pool (passes). Never use as text or a fill color outside a pool/light surface.
gold — exact brand value. PLATE-ONLY (dark-ground): 10.89:1 on background, but only 1.47:1 on the pool (fails everything on blush). Never use inside a pool.

600.$description: gold-deep — darker gold for hover/active on dark grounds

500.$description: accent / coral — exact brand value. Locked into the palette contract at gate 2 but has ZERO observed usage in the two approved mockups; kit ships it for the remaining 31-screen catalog per the future-proofing rule (step 8.5).

success.$description: plate-side success (dark ground) — exact brand value, 9.95:1 on background

warning.$description: no dedicated warning hex exists in the locked 9-token palette (a deliberate warm-only system, brief-driven — see README). Reuses secondary/gold, distinguished by icon + copy rather than hue.

danger.$description: plate-side error (dark ground) — exact brand value, 8.23:1 on background

info.$description: no cool/blue hue exists anywhere in this palette by design (warm-only system per the direction's excludes). Info reuses secondary/gold, distinguished by icon + copy — see README §No blue in this system.

base.$description: the page ground. ALWAYS rendered as a photographic plate at reduced luminance in real screens — this flat value is the fallback only (e.g. behind an image before it loads).

raised.$description: surface — a slightly raised dark plate (e.g. admin chrome under the plate, never a card)

overlay.$description: 90% plum-ink overlay — reserved for a future modal backdrop; the two approved mockups have zero modals, so this is unobserved. Never a scrim over a plate (the direction bans scrims — see excludes).

inverted.$description: the pool surface — blush. This IS the signature clearing. See color.pool for the full inverted-context token set.

primary.$description: blush — default reading text on the dark plate/ground context

secondary.$description: dim — plate-side muted/caption text, 11.38:1 on background

tertiary.$description: plate-rule reused as the dimmest plate-side text tier — 4.22:1 on background, clears large-text AA only; use for de-emphasized captions, not body

inverted.$description: poolText / ink — the primary reading color used INSIDE the pool, 17.21:1 on the pool. The highest-contrast pairing in the entire system.

default.$description: plate-rule — exact brand value, the standard dark-ground hairline, 4.22:1 on background

pool.$description: The inverted-context token family. Every screen in this direction contains exactly one hard-edged blush pool holding plum ink — this is not a light MODE, it is a per-surface inversion that co-exists with the dark ground on every viewport. Consume these tokens for anything composed INSIDE a pool/clearing.

surface.$description: the pool background — same value as color.surface.inverted

text.$description: ink — primary text inside the pool, 17.21:1

textSecondary.$description: poolTextSecondary — muted text inside the pool, 8.09:1

border.$description: pool-rule — hairline dividers inside the pool (e.g. ledger rows, admin nav), 3.98:1, clears SC 1.4.11

danger.$description: pool-side error — used for error copy/icons drawn ON the pool, 6.85:1 on pool. Distinct from color.semantic.danger, which is the plate-side value.

success.$description: pool-side success — used for confirmation copy/icons drawn ON the pool, 6.01:1 on pool.

display.$description: Display only — never body, never a form label, never below 26px. See assets.md §Style 4 hard constraints (weight 500/600 preferred on dark grounds; this direction's own approved mockup uses 400 successfully at display sizes ≥23px, see README).

xs.$description: plate-side captions / mono labels — the legibility floor's documented exception, never smaller

sm.$description: the legibility floor minimum anywhere on the public site

6xl.$description: base for the Crown ask; components clamp up to 80px fluidly in-place, this token is the floor

normal.$description: the legibility floor's minimum body line-height

relaxed.$description: dense reading prose inside the pool

tight.$description: matches the approved mockup's display heading tracking

wide.$description: eyebrow / uppercase mono labels — matches the approved mockup exactly

radius.$description: The direction's excludes forbid border-radius entirely on every non-pool, non-avatar element ("No drop shadow, no card, no rounded rectangle"; the admin CSS states it outright: "Zero radius, zero shadow anywhere — the cut edge is the only elevation and the only boundary in the system"). radius.none is the WORKING DEFAULT for Button, Card, Badge, Input and every other primitive. This scale exists for schema completeness and for the one documented exception (Avatar, a true circle) — see README §Shape law.

sm.$description: unused by this direction; kept for schema completeness

md.$description: unused by this direction; kept for schema completeness

lg.$description: unused by this direction; kept for schema completeness

xl.$description: unused by this direction; kept for schema completeness

2xl.$description: unused by this direction; kept for schema completeness

full.$description: the ONE radius this direction actually uses — true circles only (Avatar). Never a pill button or a rounded card.

shadow.$description: This direction uses NO shadows anywhere — the cut edge between plate and pool is the only elevation cue in the system (see admin CSS comment: "Zero radius, zero shadow anywhere"). This scale is kept for schema completeness and for kit components used outside this direction's own screens (e.g. a future browser-default focus ring fallback); do not apply any of these to Button/Card/Badge defaults.

motion.$description: motion_intensity: 3 (dial) — fades and linear micro-transitions only, no spring by default. The approved mockups use almost no motion: one 24s ambient scale-drift on the hero plate, and 140ms linear color/text-decoration transitions on admin links. duration.normal is locked to 150ms per the dial mapping.

ambient.$description: the hero plate's one-time-only ambient drift, matching the approved mockup exactly

linear.$description: the approved mockup's admin micro-transitions use linear exclusively

spring.$description: NOT used by default anywhere in this direction (motion_intensity <= 3 bars spring-by-default). Kept for schema completeness only.
